exam.title: Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central Functional Consultant
exam.study_prerequisites: Applied Business Central functional-consulting experience across company setup and migration, security, dimensions, workflows, financial configuration, posting groups, receivables, payables, fixed assets, sales, purchasing, inventory, journals, corrections and reconciliations, plus the ability to trace documents through subledgers and the general ledger.

review.notes: Every June 30, 2026 subobjective maps to a company/setup/master record, permission/control, business document, state transition, posting matrix, ledger entry, correction, reconciliation or evidence decision. Three scenarios, eight labs and 36 checks cover all four domains. All 15 URLs are cataloged: 13 reachable, with O'Reilly and Udemy automation-blocked; none missing or broken. The guide records the active 100-minute eight-language exam, free assessment, 43h40 official paths, five-day course, MIT labs, June blueprint changes and current commercial-resource boundaries.

sources.title: Process financial operations in Business Central

findings.resolution: Use current setup and separate draft creation from approval/posting.

findings.title: Known-sender policy has conditional scope
findings.evidence: Settings and monitored subfolder determine whether policy is used.

findings.resolution: Add scenario matrix and distinct invoice review.

findings.title: Forwarded email and initial quote have specific semantics
findings.evidence: Sender address drives contact lookup and quote does not reserve stock.
findings.recommendation: Add verified contact-association and document-state controls.
findings.resolution: Add verified contact-association and document-state controls.

findings.title: G/L revaluation must not duplicate subledger adjustment
findings.evidence: Direct source-currency balances produce grouped journal adjustments.
findings.recommendation: Add two-period valuation example with unchanged foreign-currency balance.
findings.resolution: Add two-period valuation example with unchanged foreign-currency balance.

findings.title: Closing periods is not a complete posting lock
findings.evidence: Prior-year entries remain possible within allowed posting ranges.
findings.recommendation: Explain irreversible close and required income-close rerun.
findings.resolution: Explain irreversible close and required income-close rerun.

offline_checks: 34 assertions across permissions union, inventory cost split, receipt limits, bank timing/fees, discounts/deferral/allocation, FX and catalog arithmetic.

limitations: No Business Central tenant, invoice/payment/posting, bank export, agent activation/email, paid-content or exam-assessment execution.
Offline calculations are simplified models, not proof of platform accounting, access control, rounding or agent behavior.
Long product references read in specified sections; complete localization/version/permission/feature matrices and linked procedures not audited.
Community inventory article accepted only for reconciliation prompts; inaccurate setup mapping and generic defaults rejected. Historical agent preview article does not establish current availability.
Direct commercial fetches blocked; indexed public metadata separately recorded. Practice/partner shells unavailable and Pluralsight/Whizlabs not comprehensively re-searched.
Same-context AI review; independent human review and live labs remain pending.
